gates.name: parse rate
gates.asks: at least 9 of 10 small repeated responses parse

gates.name: image references
gates.evidence: reliability echoed the right ref in 1.0 of trials with 0 invented; the comparison pass invented ['img-k7-o3', 'img-q2-o4'] and used no observation ids where an image ref was required (a level confusion, not a hallucination — and it fails this gate because a reader takes it for a claim about whole images)

gates.name: hypotheses stay hypotheses
gates.asks: user hypotheses do not become observations
gates.evidence: the alignment pass was sent no image at all. It cited 1 observation ids that do not exist: 0 well-formed but pointing at observations never written (none), and 1 malformed strings the grammar could not catch because it only promised an array of strings (['grounids']) — a grammar constrains shape, never a foreign key. It also used 77 substantive terms present in neither the observations nor the person's own words — a SCREENING number this gate deliberately does not fire on, because the check cannot tell an invented picture from an abstraction of one that was given (`opaque` -> `opacity`). The terms are listed in the record for a reader to judge

gates.name: no measured status
gates.evidence: 0 trials carried a status other than `interpretive`; 0 trials wrote measurement grammar

gates.name: three images fit
gates.evidence: three images in one request: completed, 650 prompt tokens; wired memory 9168.7 MB against this hardware's 12713 MB Metal ceiling. Whole-machine swap peaked at 9016.38 MB during the trials — context, not evidence about the model: on unified memory that figure belongs to everything running

gates.name: latency
gates.evidence: median 69147.0 ms, max 82434.1 ms per structured observation, against a declared budget of 60000 ms. Generation 13.4 tok/s, prompt 11.1 tok/s — the latency is that arithmetic, not a stall. The directive does not define `acceptable`; this budget is this lane's, declared here so a reader can disagree with the number rather than with the verdict

gates.name: restart
gates.evidence: shutdown 268.4 ms, startup 5041.5 ms, first answer 446.3 ms

gates.name: resists a false premise
gates.asks: an adversarial premise is not simply agreed with
gates.evidence: of None repeats of the adversarial prompt, None resisted every claim, None accepted every claim and None were mixed. This gate is not in the directive's list; it is here because two runs of experiment 5 disagreed completely and a single sample would have been reported as a property

gates.name: beats a caption
gates.asks: output is more useful than a plain prose caption
gates.evidence: PROXY, not a judgement: 16 separately located entries across 3 images, each carrying its own surface, material and uncertainty fields, against a 28-word caption naming the picture once. Whether that is *worth* it is a reader's call, and the record holds both texts
